name: formguard-lite
description: Stateless, zero-dependency spam guard for plain HTML forms and React: honeypot, time trap, interaction gate, canvas captcha, obfuscated action.

scripts.build: npx -y terser@5 formguard.js -c -m --comments '/^!/' -o dist/formguard.min.js && npx esbuild react/FormGuard.jsx --format=esm --jsx=automatic --target=es2019 --legal-comments=inline --outfile=dist/react.mjs
scripts.test: node test/codec.test.js && node test/dom.test.js && FG_FILE=dist/formguard.min.js node test/dom.test.js && node test/run-react.js

author: Vikas Bhagwagar (https://github.com/vikaskbh)
